finding: src/anomaly/owners.py:28 The consolidated dynamic-review boundary still exposes two live names for the same attestation field instead of a clean alias-free contract.
rationale: The public run_workflow → invoke_resolved_owner → consume_owner path applies no upstream shape guard, and _review_owner_result demonstrably accepts both the installed persona’s attestation field and the focused recovery fixture’s independent_attestation field as the same canonical value, so the duplicate live contract is reachable and violates the task’s explicit unused-alias removal criterion.

evidence.output: run_workflow wraps the supplied invoke callback with invoke_resolved_owner; invoke_resolved_owner returns the callback result unchanged; the P0-P7 loop passes that result through consume_owner. No upstream response-field guard selects one attestation name.

_REVIEW_FIELDS contains both "independent_attestation" and "attestation". _review_owner_result rejects only fields outside that set, then converts attestation to independent_attestation; it rejects only the case where both are simultaneously present.

agents/anomaly-data-reviewer.md:19 and :52-53 instruct the live persona to return attestation; tests/test_pipeline_walk.py:42 uses independent_attestation in the focused canonical dynamic-review fixture.
